verdict.summary: The round-2 approval remains supported. The numeric readers are total for the accepted input types, including the oversized-integer mean case; malformed sent fields hide the whole affected statistic and emit bounded, shape-only diagnostics, while absent/null fields retain the documented defaults. The call-site tests distinguish each reader contract, exercise container and field failures, guard against crash-after-partial-run false kills, and verify the delivered browser behavior with a DOM shim whose child count now follows append/replace operations. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, fail-closed, privacy, or injection issue in the diff. Because both round 2 and round 3 have zero findings, progress is stagnant under the supplied scale rather than improving.
